Pear Crisps
By: Nikki Brown
Published: Friday, September 22, 2017 - 2:51pm

Ingredients




2 pears
1 tbsp. coconut oil

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 170C/340F. 2 Thinly slice the pears and drizzle the coconut oil over. 3 Bake in the oven for 1 and half hours, then flip the pear slices over and bake for another 1 and half hours.

About

For a fruity and delicious healthy alternative to crisps – you need to give this nutritious recipe a try. It’s really simple to make. It does take a while to get them super crispy in the oven, but it’s definitely worth the wait.
